title: T0004 virtual-brain modeling methods: verification and recommended modeling path
body:
SUMMARY
Wang et al. (2025) 'Virtual brain twins for stimulation in epilepsy' is verified: Nat Comput Sci 5(9):754-768, DOI 10.1038/s43588-025-00841-6, PMID 40764764, PMC12457187, CC BY 4.0. Its Code availability names GitHub HuifangWang/VBT_INS_Stimulation and two Code Ocean capsules (10.24433/CO.3316132.v1 Part 1, 10.24433/CO.2143670.v1 Part 2). All three identifiers resolve.

VERIFIED FACTS
- GitHub repo is public. Apache-2.0. HEAD 5367ef4afb976271ecc6297b70a95dd3d944af61 (2025-11-11). Releases 0.1.0 (2025-10-09, from branch esd_integration) and 0.1.0a1. pyproject on main still says 0.1.0a1. The python package is 'vep-stim' (Python >=3.8; deps cmdstanpy, mne, nibabel, numpy, scipy, pandas, openpyxl, parfor, tvb-library, matplotlib; numba used implicitly). It is not on PyPI. The README pins external tools: FreeSurfer (written '6. 3.0'), MRtrix 0.3.16, FSL 5.0.11, GARDEL 1.0, SimNIBS 4.0, Brainstorm3, Stan 2.21.0, make, GNU Parallel. The structural pipeline is ins-amu/tvb-pipeline and the parcellation is HuifangWang/VEP_atlas_shared. Neither declares a licence.
- Code Ocean: both DOIs resolve to capsules 8462474 and 4238253. DataCite rights: GPL plus CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (Part 1) and GPL plus CC BY-NC 4.0 (Part 2). These licences differ from GitHub's Apache-2.0. Capsule pages returned HTTP 403 to scripted access, so their contents are unverified (need N004).
- Patient raw data is not public; access is on request from the authors.
- Method content: region-level 2D Epileptor on the VEP atlas (162 regions), inverted with Stan NUTS (16 chains from 8 MAP initialisations). The high-resolution (~20k-vertex) Epileptor-Stimulation model simulates seizures induced by SEEG or TI stimulation. Validation covers n=2 patients (Engel II and Engel I) plus synthetic ground truth. The paper's purpose is EZN DIAGNOSIS. Therapeutic stimulation optimisation is stated as future work, and the authors note the pipeline is computationally expensive and parameter sensitive.
- TVB: tvb-library 2.10.0 (PyPI 2025-07-22; GPL-3.0-or-later; Python >=3.8). tvb-root HEAD 928f90d (2026-10-20). The Epileptor, Epileptor2D and EpileptorRestingState classes are present.
- BVEP: ins-amu/BVEP, GPL-3.0, HEAD 69baec4 (2025-09-15), release v0.1 (2021). Paper: Hashemi et al. 2020 NeuroImage 217:116839. Implementations in Stan, PyMC3, sbi and optimisation code are research notebooks with unpinned versions.
- Supporting clinical-scale evidence for VEP: Wang et al. 2023 Sci Transl Med (n=53 retrospective; precision 0.6). All of these papers share one study family (Marseille/INS); patient overlap is unknown.

RECOMMENDATION
Primary path: region-level virtual epileptic patient built on the VBT_INS_Stimulation code, pinned at commit 5367ef4. Use its Stan 2D-Epileptor inference (vep_mcmc.stan) on presurgical SEEG envelopes to get an x0 posterior per patient. Then run forward simulations in TVB (tvb-library 2.10.0) with the repo's Epileptor-Stimulation model, comparing each intervention (virtual resection or ablation by node removal, and stimulation at the delivered or candidate contacts) against a paired no-intervention baseline per posterior sample. This matches the protocol's virtual_patient endpoint. The intervention-comparison layer is new code that R3/R4 must write and validate; it is not in the paper. Skip the high-resolution surface and the TI/scalp-EEG parts unless a case has the required imaging.
Fallback path: TVB Epileptor network baseline (tvb-library 2.10.0) with x0 set from the clinical EZ/PZ hypothesis, or fitted with the BVEP Stan models via cmdstanpy. Use the patient connectome if DWI exists, otherwise a template connectome, and label such cases 'non-personalised'. This path runs natively on Windows with Python 3.10/3.11 plus CmdStan and needs no FreeSurfer/MRtrix/FSL.

WHAT THE USER MUST APPROVE (installs)
(a) Python 3.10/3.11 env with tvb-library 2.10.0, cmdstanpy 1.3.x, mne, nibabel, numba, openpyxl, parfor, and the vep-stim repo at a pinned commit. (b) CmdStan plus a C++ toolchain (README pins Stan 2.21.0; compatibility with newer CmdStan is untested). (c) Only for patient-specific structural scaffolds: WSL2 or Docker with FreeSurfer (licence key required), MRtrix 0.3.16, FSL 5.0.11, and GARDEL (CT contact localisation). Optional: SimNIBS 4.0 and Brainstorm3 (MATLAB) for TI/scalp-EEG. (d) Optional tvb-data 3.0.0 (~52 MB) for a template connectome.

OPEN QUESTIONS
1. Do any candidate public datasets provide DWI and post-implant CT (or contact coordinates in MRI space) alongside SEEG? Without them, personalisation reduces to a template connectome. This should be answered by the R1 dataset tasks.
2. Capsule contents, environment and account requirements are unverified (N004). The licence conflict between GitHub (Apache-2.0) and Code Ocean (GPL, CC BY-NC-ND) needs resolving before redistributing derived code or data.
3. Is Stan 2.21 required, or does a current CmdStan work? This is untested.
4. Neither tvb-pipeline nor VEP_atlas_shared declares a licence; reuse terms must be confirmed with the authors.
5. The protocol's 'model-guided intracranial stimulation' comparison has no validated precedent in Wang 2025, so any simulated stimulation effect is a simulated_result with no clinical validation.
6. Paper discrepancy (minor): 20,284 vs 20,484 cortical vertices.

Artifacts: MethodCards A0037 (VBT), A0039 (TVB), A0041 (BVEP); AccessRecords A0043, A0045, A0047, A0049, A0051, A0053, A0054; EvidenceClaims A0055, A0056, A0057. reproduction_status = not_attempted for all methods. Sources screened: about 14 (PMC/Europe PMC full text, GitHub API x6 repos, DataCite x2, Crossref x5, PyPI x4).
